model.source_system: 2048 merge mechanics (original open-source implementation gabrielecirulli/2048, MIT), transcribed as a deterministic 2x2 variant: slide + merge only, random tile spawns not collected

Per-rule citations in meta.rules_with_citations; per-edge generating rules in meta.edge_rule_tags.
